results.title: ¡Ya Basta! 30 Years of Zapatista Autonomy
results.overview: In the mountains of Chiapas, a rebel experiment in autonomy continues to thrive – thirty years after its declaration of war against the Mexican state. ¡Ya Basta! 30 Years of Zapatista Autonomy, a Modern Insurgent documentary, explores the legacy and future of the EZLN, reflecting on how a masked, rural rebellion reshaped Mexico’s political landscape and inspired activists across the globe. What does revolution look like when it refuses to seize state power? And what can the world learn from a community that continues to build its own system from the ground up?

results.title: School of Magical Animals 4
results.overview: Ida's friend Miriam visits the school for three months, but a secret threatens to tear them apart. Miriam is entrusted with the tarsier Fitzgeraldo, while Max, deeply in love, is given the owl Muriel. Meanwhile, the sale of the school is imminent, and the future of the magical community is in peril.

results.title: Housefull
results.overview: Housefull is a Sinhala movie starring Isuru Lokuhettiarachchi, Chulakshi Ranathunga and Jeewan Kumaranatunga in prominent roles. It is directed by Sri Lal Priyadeva.

results.title: Liza Minnelli: The Last Heiress of Hollywood
results.original_title: Liza Minnelli, la dernière héritière d'Hollywood
results.overview: Singer, dancer, and actress, Liza, daughter of Vincente Minnelli and Judy Garland, with whom she had a close relationship, made a name for herself on Broadway and in Hollywood with her unique voice and flamboyant style. A sensitive portrait of the unforgettable Sally Bowles from Cabaret.

results.title: Flush
results.overview: A middle-aged cocaine addict becomes trapped in a nightclub bathroom while trying to win back his ex-girlfriend, setting off a night of increasingly bizarre and grotesque chaos.

results.title: Agregados obreros
results.overview: Explores the figure of the labor attaché as a diplomatic figure that emerged during Perón's first administration in Argentina. This initiative represented a cultural conflict by opening spaces in Argentine politics, such as the foreign ministry and foreign relations, to workers.

results.title: Host
results.overview: Ing is sent to Pinijkhun Reform School, an all-girls facility on a remote island. The only rule here is that everyone must obey orders.

results.title: Baby Gay
results.overview: Desperate to finally prove her bisexuality, Stevie Lee bluffs her way into a lesbian threesome thinking she'll "figure it out" when she gets there. She does not figure it out when she gets there.

results.title: Last House
results.overview: Small time burglars Max and Dee must put their differences aside to get through the last job of the day, but things aren't what they seem this time.

results.title: Our Times
results.overview: Husband and wife Nora and Héctor's scientific breakthrough lets them time travel from 1966 to 2025. As Héctor struggles, Nora thrives—but at what cost?

results.title: Upallay
results.overview: Upallay follows the story of Beto, a young journalist eagerly awaiting the birth of his first child with the love of his life. He receives a visit from Luis, his best friend, who invites him on a journey to the Peruvian highlands to cover a strange event taking place during the Internal Armed Conflict. It’s the opportunity they’ve been waiting for—to use journalism as a tool for social change and a means to uncover the truth in a time of terror and uncertainty. Despite the fear and the risk, Beto accepts the challenge, driven by his commitment to the truth. However, upon arriving in the conflict zone, the team is warned of the dangers they face. In the midst of the chaos, they are mistaken for terrorists and sentenced to death by an Andean community.

results.title: Killjote
results.overview: The neighbors on Cristo Street gossip in the cool evening until they hear loud moans coming from Carmen’s house. At first, they sound like pleasure, but soon they turn into something much stranger.

results.title: Proxy Me
results.overview: A day in the lives of people connected by a person-for-hire service, that allows you to substitute yourself.

results.title: The Confession
results.overview: A catholic priest in Monte Bello, El Salvador has created a clandestine operating room inside the church to extract the human organs of kidnapped people and sell them on the black market.

results.title: The Demoness
results.overview: A demonic succubus travels to Earth to torment the human race.

results.title: The Little Panthers
results.overview: One day before the beginning of the pandemic lockdown, a peculiar couple walks through the city of Salta, postponing a crucial decision: whether or not to spend the quarantine together.

results.title: Strange River
results.overview: One summer, Dídac travels by bike along the Danube with his family, starting where the river first emerges in Germany. As they journey downstream, he begins seeing a mysterious boy, Alexander, who appears and disappears in the water. Dídac feels himself changing, drawn toward Alexander and away from his brother Biel. Their mother, Monika, who once took the same trip as a teenager, drifts into memories of a past summer love. When she sees Dídac and Alexander together, she encourages them to continue the journey alone. But as twilight falls, Dídac begins to question who Alexander truly is.

results.title: SENIOR CONSULTANT!
results.overview: A group of optimistic British Millennials compete for a bullshit corporate job title. What could possibly go wrong?
